transcript:
# MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES

**Date:** Thursday, April 16, 2026
**Location:** Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, Room 105.
**Commissioners in attendance:** Inna Babitskaya, Vice Chair; Matthew Bach; Keith Jackson; John Parcellin (alternate member); Elizabeth Salazar. Emma Taddeo.
**City Staff:** Michelle Romero, Clerk to the Commission.

Babitskaya called the meeting to order at 4:01 pm, took a roll call and chaired the meeting.

1. 54-72 Summer Street (Parcel ID 022 130 019) Notice of Intent to Alter Building (Inventoried MHC MAL. 258, 259 & 260) (replace 24 lintels, repoint as needed). Determination of Significance. Determination of Significance. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance (MCC, Title 4.24)
   *Pending complete NOI Application.*

   Romero confirmed no additional information had been received re: the NOI Application previously forwarded to the Commission for advance review. The Applicant was not in attendance. The Commission found the NOI Application incomplete and took no action.

   *On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Parcellin not voting).*

2. 808 Salem Street (Parcel ID 133 663 317) Permit # CMID-040128-2021.
   Notice of Intent to Alter Building (Inventoried MHC MAL. 32) (deck & balcony addition, replacement window, four-family dwelling). Status Update (Determination of Significance dated November 20, 2025, Preferably Preserved Status dated March 19, 2026).
   Determination of Significance. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance (MCC, Title 4.24)

   The Commission reviewed its determination dated March 31, 2026 and received an update from Romero re: communications with Applicant re: the status of the balcony/deck and withdrawn portion of the project for the replacement window. Applicant was not in attendance at the meeting and provided no written update re: the balcony/deck, as required by condition 6 of the Commission's determination dated March 31, 2026.

   The Commission discussed Applicant's noncompliance and possible consequences, such as the Commission's rescinding its decision and fines. The Commission discussed whether interpreter/translation service may be helpful to Applicant and will offer to provide translation services for Applicant (provided by City remote service used by the City) at the next meeting.

   The Commission reviewed an email from Building Commissioner Nelson Miller dated April 16, 2026 re: the recommended course of action re: the window that Commission learned at the last meeting had been removed and the window opening covered over with vinyl siding, without the required building permit and during the course of the Commission's review of the NOI Application re: alterations to the same subject area. The Commission requests that Miller proceed with the recommended course of action and also requests that the building permit for the balcony/deck not be issued, given the noncompliance with the Commission's decision.

   *On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Jackson, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Parcellin not voting).*

3. Other Business.
   a. Malden Landmarks. The Commission received and discussed the draft information re: Malden Landmarks prepared by Babitskaya. The Commission will review and edit in preparation for posting on the Commission's page on the City website. The Commission discussed preparing a map of locations. The Commission will review the Malden Historic Walking Tour Map prepared previously.
   b. Architectural Syles Guide. The Commission discussed the status of this, currently being worked on by Bach.
   c. Delegation of Authority to make Determination of Significance, Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24, MCC.
      The Commission discussed the option provided by the Ordinance to delegate its authority to make Determinations of Significance, and requested Romero provide a list of types of alterations and properties where this may be appropriate.

At approximately 5:05 pm, Bach left the meeting. Parcellin will vote in Bach's absence.

4. 1100 Main Street (Parcel ID 044 855 507) Permit # CMID-067648-2024.
   Status Update for Building Demolished (Determination of Significance dated March 20, 2025).
   Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance (MCC, Title 4.24)

   The Commission reviewed the proposed historical signage/plaque, including, text, dimensions, material and location, provided by Kimberly (Kemberly) Rodrigues, Prestige Wash, Property Manager, New York Capital Investment Group.
   The Commission will notify the Applicant that the size is acceptable; bronze preferred for durability; and content/text is under review, to be revised by Babitskaya; and inquire re: last line of sign, "Prepared by…".

   *On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Jackson, yes; Parcellin, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Bach, absent).*

5. 245 Bryant Street (Parcel ID 097 424 414) Permit #CMID-069419-2024.
   Status Update for Building determined to be Preferably Preserved.
   Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated January 23, 2025, amended March 20, 2025).
   Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.

   The Commission received a written update dated April 16, 2026 from Muge Undemir, Director of Real Estate, Asian Community Development Corporation.

6. 100 Hospital Road (Parcel ID 025 104 401) & 57 Hospital Road (Parcel ID 025 104 501). Permit #CMID-051597-2022. Status update for Buildings Determined to be Preferably Preserved, Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated March 22, 2023, amended April 20, 2023).
   Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.

   Romero informed the Commission of communication with Ryan Fuller, Tufts Medicine, re: his recent absence and the incomplete status of update.

7. 15 Ferry Street (Parcel ID 075 272 211)/Permit #CMID-062907-2023.
   New application/Demolition Permit issued March 6, 2024 (Permit #CMID-062907-2023).
   Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.

8. 15 Ferry Street (Parcel ID 075 272 211)/Permit #CMID-029312-2019.
   Status update for Building Determined to be Preferably Preserved (Determination dated June 6, 2019, extended/amended April 21, 2022), (Demolition Permit Application withdrawn May 31, 2022).
   Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.

9. One Salem Street (Parcel ID 075 272 209)/Permit #CMID-029311-2019.
   Status Update for Building determined to be Preferably Preserved, Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated December 4, 2019, amended January 27, 2020).

   The Commission received an update from Romero re: status of the permitting process for the project. No update received from Applicant. The Commission will review its draft recommendation letter to the City Council with the Commission's decision and recommendations of December 18, 2025.

10. Local Historic District Study Committee. Romero informed the Commission of the resignation of two members of the Committee, David Hancock and Kate Hriczo Woodard.

11. Other business, continued.
    d. The Commission discussed notice to property owners of inventory. Romero will forward draft discussed by Commission in prior years.
    e. The Commission discussed educational programs.

12. Community Preservation Committee. Babitskaya gave an update.
    Babitskaya informed the Commission that her term had ended and inquired whether any other Commissioner wanted to serve as the Commission's CPC representative.

    Babitskaya was nominated to continue as the Commission's CPC representative.
    Parcellin was nominated as the Commission's CPC representative.

    *On the motion of Parcellin to nominate Babitskaya, seconded by Salazar, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Jackson, yes; Parcellin, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Bach, absent).*

    The motion by Taddeo to nominate Parcellin was not seconded.

13. Other business, continued.
    f. The Commission delegated its authority to Romero to make a Determination of Significance, pursuant to the Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24, MCC for the following NOI Applications, which are pending completion and/or expected to be filed:
       - 11 Gale Street (Parcel ID 028 153 322) Permit # RES-076438-2026. Notice of Intent to Demolish Building (Accessory Garage Only) Determination of Significance.
       - 57 Newman Road, Unit 10 (Parcel ID 068 301 101 10) Permit # RES-076654-2026. Notice of Intent to Alter Building Inventoried MHC MAL. Q) (replacement windows, doors).

14. Approval of Minutes.
    The Commission reviewed and approved the minutes of the March 2026 meeting.
    *On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Jackson, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Jackson, yes; Parcellin, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Bach, absent).*

15. Next meeting: May 21, 2026.

16. Adjournment: 5:48 pm. On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Parcellin, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Babitskaya, yes; Jackson, yes; Parcellin, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Bach, absent).

Inna Babitskaya, Chair

---

**Date:** Thursday, April 16, 2026 2:00:06 PM
**Attachments:** image001.png, image002.png

Michelle,

I have reviewed item B of the determination for the property located at 808 Salem Street, and can provide the following recommended course of action.

1. The property owner will be issued a violation notice informing her that work has been performed without a building permit in violation of 780 CMR, The Massachusetts State Building Code.
2. The violation notice will order the owner to apply for a building permit to repair the unlawful work.
3. The building permit application for the repair work will trigger a review by the Historical Commission, at which time the Commission can address the possible methods of repair, and can place any conditions which fall under the purview of the Demolition / Alteration Delay Ordinance.
4. The permit to repair the unlawful work will be issued with the final conditions included.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns, or if I can help in any way,

Nelson

headline: Found a Summer Street application incomplete, ordered compliance steps for a Salem Street project, and approved plaque details for 1100 Main Street.
summary: The commission found the Notice of Intent for 54-72 Summer Street incomplete and took no action. It voted 5-0 to have the Building Commissioner proceed with his recommended enforcement steps for 808 Salem Street and withhold the balcony/deck permit, and voted 5-0 to approve plaque wording details for 1100 Main Street. It also delegated authority to Romero to decide two pending applications and voted 5-0 to keep Babitskaya as its Community Preservation Committee representative.
decisions: Found the Notice of Intent Application for 54-72 Summer Street incomplete and took no action; motion passed 5-0.
Voted 5-0 to have Building Commissioner Miller proceed with his recommended course of action and to request the building permit for the balcony/deck not be issued for 808 Salem Street.
Voted 5-0 to notify the Applicant for 1100 Main Street that the sign size is acceptable, bronze is preferred, and the content/text is under review.
Voted 5-0 to nominate Inna Babitskaya to continue as the Commission's representative to the Community Preservation Committee.
Delegated authority to Romero to make Determinations of Significance for the pending NOI applications at 11 Gale Street and 57 Newman Road, Unit 10.
